name: Casas de Reina (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a green cross throughout, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Casas de Reina (a horseman on green, inscribed REGINA TURDULORUM).
history: Municipal flag of Casas de Reina; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Casas de Reina arms — horseman on green, inscribed REGINA TURDULORUM
